searchText: Doesn't each EIP have an EthMag thread already? You think we should have a discord channel per included EIP as well? I feel like EthMag is that. But a lot of stuff happens outside of it and it doesn't always get ported back to Ethmag https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7549-move-committee-index-outside-attestation/16390 not much in there I don't want to speak for everyone, but I think that most ad-hoc discussions happen on Discord/Telegram, so why don't we pick one and stick to it? It would make ~~everyone's lives~~ my life much easier porting anything sounds very naive IMO because who will do the write-ups of main points of each discussion? I have a tendency to over-regulate things, so take this with a grain of salt, but it is annoying when someone says "This EIP has known issues A, B and C" and I have never heard of this because I have been probably paying attention to the wrong places Or there were some private discussions that I was not a part of The real-world example is EIP-7549, where pushing the EIP to the F-fork was discussed because of some issues, but I had no clue about them I wouldn't even know where to look for them 😅 I wonder if something like "Place X is the single source of truth for EIPs. Unless Y is explained there, there is no expectation that every team knows about Y" would help Y could be anything: a known issue, a short description of an important insight, meeting notes etc <@504202741933932544> anything for you to share on 7549 and trickyness in it? ^
